creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`muster pane resize --equalize` landed in `a_2KIH8WAnU` with no keybinding, deliberately: Muster has no chord that moves a divider either - that is the drag - and a chord means an `Action` variant, the hardcoded `Action::ALL` length bumped, a menu item, a default chord and a line in `docs/configuration.md`.

Worth doing if evening a tab turns out to be something you reach for while your hands are on the keyboard. Raised so the decision is visible rather than lost in the verb's commit.
title: 🎹 No chord evens out a tab
